title: ribes uva-crispa subsp. atlanticum
intro: Ribes uva-crispa subsp. atlanticum, commonly known as the Atlantic Gooseberry, is a subspecies of shrub native to the western coast of Europe and North Africa. This plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ribes uva-crispa subsp. atlanticum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ribesartanes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, such as kaempferol, quercetin, and myricetin, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
